title_en: College of Engineering Photo Zone and Academic Gown Rental for the 80th Late-Term (August) Degree Recipients
summary: The College of Engineering will rent academic gowns and operate photo zones for its 80th late-term degree recipients from 13 August to 31 August 2026. Gown rental requires an online application and the borrower's own identification document, and gowns must be returned by 17:00 on the day after rental.
applies_to: College of Engineering 80th late-term degree recipients (공과대학 제80회 후기 학위수여자)

dates.what: Gown rental operating hours (closed during lunch, 12:00–13:00)

dates.when: By 17:00 on the day after rental

dates.original_ko: 금요일 대여 시 차주 월요일 반납

dates.what: College of Engineering photo zone operation

dates.when: Friday 28 August 2026, the day of the degree conferment ceremony

steps: Apply for an academic gown online at https://student-eng.snu.ac.kr/ between 13 August and 31 August 2026.
Collect the gown at the academic gown storage room next to the security office on the 1st floor of Building 39, on a weekday between 10:00 and 17:00 (not between 12:00 and 13:00).
Bring an identification document in your own name: a resident registration card, driver's licence or passport. A student ID card is not accepted.

If a proxy will rent or return the gown on your behalf, the proxy must submit the Letter of Authorisation for Receipt [수령위임장] (Attachment 2) and a copy of your (the delegator's) identification document.
Return the gown to the same storage room by 17:00 on the day after rental. If you rent on a Friday, return it on the following Monday.
For the detailed rental and return procedure, refer to Attachment 1 [붙임1] (its content was not read; it is not included in the text of the notice).
translation:
The College of Engineering will conduct academic gown rental for the 80th late-term degree recipients as set out below. Eligible students are asked to review this notice.

A. Eligible: College of Engineering 80th late-term degree recipients

B. Detailed plan

1. Academic gown rental
- Period: Thursday 13 August 2026 to Monday 31 August 2026
- Application method: online application (https://student-eng.snu.ac.kr/)
- Open on weekdays from 10:00 to 17:00 (closed during lunch, 12:00 to 13:00).
- As a rule, gowns must be returned by 17:00 on the day after rental.
- Bring an identification document in your own name (student ID cards are not accepted).
- Rental and return by a proxy is permitted (the proxy must submit the Letter of Authorisation for Receipt [수령위임장] (Attachment 2) and a copy of the delegator's identification document).
- Location: academic gown storage room next to the security office, 1st floor, Building 39
- Note: Gowns rented on a Friday are to be returned on the following Monday.

2. College of Engineering photo zone
- Period: Thursday 13 August 2026 to Monday 31 August 2026
- Locations: Basement level 1, Building 39; 2nd-floor entrance, Building 301

3. Coffee truck and 'Life Four Cuts' [인생네컷]
- Date: Friday 28 August 2026, the day of the degree conferment ceremony
- Locations: Building 39; 2nd floor, Building 301

C. Academic gown rental and return procedure: please refer to the guide in Attachment 1 [붙임1].

D. Requests for cooperation
1) An identification document is required for rental (resident registration card, driver's licence or passport are accepted; student ID cards are not accepted).
2) Please ensure that no gowns go unreturned.

Attachments (3):
- (Attachment) 80th Late-Term Degree Conferment Ceremony Graduate Celebration Plan (Draft), sent to departments [(붙임) 제80회 후기 학위수여식 졸업생 축하 계획(안)_학과부 발송.pdf]
- Letter of Authorisation for Receipt [수령위임장.pdf]
- 80th Late-Term (August 2026) Academic Gown Rental Guide, College of Engineering [제80회 후기(2026.8.)학위복 대여 안내문_공과대학.pdf]

Note: The attached PDF files were not read; their content is not included in this translation.
